author: The Critical Drinker
description:
Critical Drinker film premiere and Fan Meetup in London, September 10th! Get your tickets here: https://www.tickettailor.com/events/gradualupgradeproductions/2331646

Join me and the Open Bar crew for a chat about Spider-Man: Brand New Day! Also, Children Of Blood and Bone just got slated... by the author of the book its based one. So grab a drink and hang out with me, MauLer, Az, Reaper, Chris Gore, DarkHour and Generation Offended for Open Bar 194. 

Subscribe to Az: https://www.youtube.com/@HeelvsBabyface

title: Open Bar #194 - Spider-Man Is Here!
